finding1_tautological_isNotNull_after_by.evidence: FunnelIndexesIT lines 67, 84, 87: bare byKey() calls with no isNotNull() assertion on the returned Document. byKey() throws AssertionError if the index is absent, so the assertion is now implicit and non-tautological. The only assertions that follow byKey() are on .getBoolean("unique") and partialFilterExpression content — both meaningful.

finding2_deepCopy_4_of_11_fields.evidence: FunnelStepTest.deepCopyProducesIndependentStep now populates all 11 fields including customFieldValue (line 28). Initial equality is asserted for all 11 fields (lines 33-43). Copy-independence (copy mutated, source unchanged) verified for all 11 fields (lines 46-68). Source-independence (source mutated, copy unchanged) verified for all 11 fields (lines 71-93). customFieldValue tested in both directions: copy.setCustomFieldValue("silver") does not affect original (still "gold"), and original.setCustomFieldValue("src-value") does not affect copy (still "silver").

finding3_contextStarts_vacuous.evidence: FunnelIndexesIT lines 58-59: after asserting getCollectionNames() contains both collections, the test now additionally calls indexes("funnels").isNotEmpty() and indexes("funnel_executions").isNotEmpty(). Because listIndexes() forces materialisation of the collection and its index set, and every collection carries at least _id_, a non-empty result proves real collection creation — not just context startup.

finding4_no_empty_string_triggerValue_IT.evidence: New test activeFunnelTriggerUniquenessHoldsForEmptyTriggerValue (lines 115-139): (a) inserts one active funnel with triggerValue="" — succeeds; (b) inserts second active funnel with same (projectId, triggerType, triggerValue="") — asserts DuplicateKeyException or DataIntegrityViolationException is thrown; (c) inserts two more active funnels with distinct triggerValues ("promo", "vip") — both succeed; (d) counts all three surviving funnels for the projectId and asserts count==3. Finally block cleans up inserted documents.

summary: All four round-1 findings are fully resolved. The tautological isNotNull calls are gone — byKey() now throws on absence, making the assertion implicit and correct. The deepCopy test exercises all 11 FunnelStep fields in both independence directions, including customFieldValue with a String scalar. The contextStarts test is no longer vacuous — it forces index listing on both collections and asserts non-empty. The new activeFunnelTriggerUniquenessHoldsForEmptyTriggerValue integration test correctly verifies the duplicate-key guard fires for empty-string triggerValue and that distinct triggerValues coexist, with proper cleanup in a finally block. No new issues were found.
